---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for SpaceWheat
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What problem does this solve?**
A clear description of the gap or friction you've hit — e.g. "I couldn't
tell which hat I had equipped without opening the controls overlay."

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What you'd want to happen instead.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any other approaches or workarounds you've tried.

**Is this physics-related?**
If your idea touches the quantum mechanics itself (a new gate, a new
observable driving story beats, etc.), say so explicitly — those changes get
extra scrutiny for physical correctness, not just gameplay feel.

**Additional context**
Anything else — mockups, references to similar mechanics elsewhere, etc.
